basic_info.description: Experience the epitome of luxury living in this fully renovated gem nestled in the heart of Central Sunset! This dazzling home showcases contemporary sophistication & meticulous attention to detail. Soaring 9-foot ceilings upstairs and 8.5-foot ceilings downstairs create an expansive ambiance in the open-concept living, dining & kitchen areas, bathing in abundant natural light from 5 skylights, enhanced by recessed and soft LED lighting. THE CHEF'S kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line Thermador appliances & graced w/ elegant porcelain island countertopsideal for both culinary creations & entertaining guests. Gleaming hardwood floors throughout the home are paired w/ an advanced floor heating system, ensuring ultimate comfort all year long. The living and family rooms exude style w/ chic fireplaces adorned with artistic tile designs. THE VERSATILE lower level features 2 bedrooms, including a primary suite, a wet bar, & a spacious family room that seamlessly leads to the low-maintenance backyard, offering a serene escape. Ideally located near Golden Gate Park, Irving Street's shops, eateries, banks, & public transit, quick access to major thoroughfares, it is a perfect location. Explore the 3D layout & step into your future luxurious living. CHECK IN [VIRTUAL MEDIA]
